claim.statement: OpenAI's current agent-approvals security documentation describes sandbox mode and approval policy as separate controls, says local Codex CLI uses operating-system mechanisms for sandbox policies, and says current defaults include network access off with writes limited to the active workspace.

source.title: OpenAI Agent approvals and security
source.locator: Agent approvals & security — introduction; Sandbox and approvals; Codex CLI / IDE extension; Network access

limitations: This is rolling-current publisher documentation and is not evidence that all statements applied to version 0.90.0.
The catalog did not observe operating-system enforcement, defaults or approval behavior.
unknowns: Which current security statements also applied to Codex CLI 0.90.0 beyond the tagged schema is unknown.
The effective local platform, sandbox, approval policy, workspace boundary, network state and enforcement behavior are unknown.

relationships.note: The rolling current security page and exact tagged schema overlap conceptually but have different version applicability; the catalog does not transfer the current defaults to 0.90.0.
